name: Unified Mars live geometry proof 2026-10-27
description: Sanitized public Mars snapshot geometry for an operator-created unlisted release proof. No Souls or account data. Original historical definitions and explicit root heights are preserved.

state.constitution:
# Mars two
The Mars College 2026 campus on the low Sonoran desert by the Salton Sea: Mimos (the café and lounge), the Chiba kitchen and dining hall, the Chiba auditorium, the Dojo, Tool camp and the Freeside compound.

Rebuilt in the new engine from the 2026 reference with Gene's Mimos and kitchen corrections.

def.name: core-desert-scrub
def.description: Sparse desert scrub over an area: creosote bushes (three shapes, 0.4–1.6 m) and dry grass tufts that follow the playa drainage veins; low density (default one bush per ~670 m²), optionally denser toward a side; keeps off buildings and roads and out of `clear` circles. Five instanced meshes for any size. Decor.

density.doc: bushes per m² on average (0.0015 ≈ one per 670 m²)

toward.doc: denser toward this side of the area (engine north = −z)

gradient.doc: how much denser (1 = from none at one side to double at the other)

veins.doc: how much plants follow the playa drainage veins

clear.doc: [[x, z, r], …] circles kept bare (a camp, a plaza)

def.name: core-far-land
def.description: The land beyond the walkable edge, out to ~2.3 km: coarse low-poly ground painted from data (salt flats, beaches, scrub bands, washes, deltas, playa), roads with lines and pole lines, and a sea at a level. Place once at the world centre (no name needed); it replaces the green horizon ring. Nothing on it is walkable.

radius.doc: outer reach from the entity (m); the view ends near 2.1 km from the camera

ground.doc: base colour beyond the edge (default: the terrain palette at the edge)

areas.doc: [{pts:[[x,z]…], m:"salt"|…|c:"#hex", edge?:m, shrubs?:per-ha}] polygons, painted in order

strips.doc: [{pts:[[x,z]…], w:m, m|c, edge?, shrubs?}] polylines with a width (washes, bands, tracks, beaches)

roads.doc: [{pts:[[x,z]…], w?:12, lines?:true, poles?:{side:1|-1, every:60, h:10}}] asphalt with centre and edge lines, gravel shoulders

sea.doc: {pts:[[x,z]…], level?:-1 (m from base), c?:"#hex", beach?:m} water polygon (may reach far past the radius)

def.name: mars-fidelity-kitchen
def.description: The Chiba kitchen and dining hall under the Chiba gallery, immediately west of Mimos main and as long as it (Gene's correction, true compass): the west bay is the working kitchen (perimeter counter along the west wall returning on the north with the twin sinks under the windows and on the south with the food-service window, the long stainless prep table in the middle, the commercial fridge, white fridge and chest freezer on its east side), the east bay is the dining hall with the blue wall and the bus seats along its east wall. def.name: core-tire-ring
def.description: An elliptical ring of old half-buried tyres around its point, like an abandoned dirt race track: semi-axes rx (local x) and rz (local z), turned with the entity (r). Gaps, clusters, strays and heaps inside, all from the seed. One instanced mesh; decor, Souls walk across.

burial.doc: fraction of the diameter sunk into the ground (upright tyres)

spacing.doc: mean distance between tyres along the line (m)

gaps.doc: chance a slot starts a gap

clusters.doc: chance a slot holds a cluster

strays.doc: stray tyres per line tyre, tossed off the line

strayDist.doc: how far strays land from the line (m)

innerClusters.doc: loose heaps of 3–6 tyres inside a closed line

flat.doc: share of tyres lying flat (the rest upright, a few leaning)
